headline: Cronos Lazarus DLC arrives December 3
title: Cronos Lazarus DLC | Launches Dec 3 | Gaming News
video_script: Cronos: The New Dawn is getting its first story expansion. Cronos: Lazarus launches on December third, twenty twenty six, for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. It is an expansion, so you need the base game installed to play it. A Switch 2 version is planned for early twenty twenty seven. Will you jump back into the horror? Comment below!
description: Cronos: Lazarus, the first DLC for Cronos: The New Dawn, launches December 3, 2026 on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. Sources: OpenCritic, Gamingtrend, The Outer Haven, Otaku Study.
joke: Another reason to sleep with the lights on this December.
